features.summary: HTML form and editing behavior is being refined across several user-facing areas: EditContext, the API for custom text editing, now handles composition, focus, and its anonymous editing element more reliably; select controls build their popup and row state from the DOM option list; and passkeys can appear in autocomplete="webauthn" suggestions. These fixes make native controls and advanced editors more predictable without changing their basic purpose.

features.summary: The HTML parser is being hardened and made more efficient: literal comparisons can check exact lengths without unnecessary work, and link/style lookup avoids redundant name checks. It also gains tree operations needed to sanitize markup while parsing, helping reject or transform unsafe content earlier, while fixes improve malformed formatting, nobr handling, and adoption-agency cleanup. These changes make parsing faster and more robust for both ordinary and intentionally messy HTML.
